increments.behavior: A pure helper converts between HSV, RGB and hex: hsvToRgb, rgbToHsv, rgbToHex, hsvToHex and parseHex (3 or 6 digits, optional #, case-insensitive, null when invalid).

ColourPickerWidget renders the area, hue slider, saturation and brightness sliders, swatch, hex field and RGB readout, starting at #3B82F6; every control updates all the displays; valid hex typing sets the colour and invalid hex marks the field invalid without changing it.
HomeView renders the colour picker widget after the calendar widget, leaving the other sections unchanged.
increments.doneWhen: The HomeView component test passes, and the full unit and component suites, lint and build still pass.

verification.requirement: npm run test:component passes (including component layout validation), and npm run lint and npm run build are clean
verification.result: 14 files, 96/96 tests passed; npm run lint and npm run build clean; independent reviewer ADA-VERDICT approve-with-notes
